title: Nucleofection of iPSC
author: Celeste M M. Karch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.x62frge
materials: Nucleofect with Lonza program CA-137 in P3 solution.

steps.title: Prepare iPSCs for Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Passage iPSCs as single cells 48 hours prior to nucleofection to ensure they are confluent by the time of the procedure.

substeps.instruction: Coat a 6-well plate with 1 mL Matrigel (supplemented with RGD fragment) for 1 hour.
Wash each well with 1-2 mL of PBS.
Add 1 mL of accutase per well and incubate at 37 °C for 5-10 minutes, monitoring closely for single cell dissociation.
Collect cells in 5 mL DMEM/F12 and transfer to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 750-800 rpm for 3 minutes.
Resuspend cells in mTesR1 (2 mL per well) supplemented with 1 uM Rock Inhibitor.
Plate 2 mL of cells per well on a Matrigel (supplemented with RGD fragment) coated plate.

steps.title: Prepare Post-Nucleofection Plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the plates where nucleofected cells will be recovered.

substeps.instruction: Coat 2-3 wells of a plate with Matrigel supplemented with RGD for 1 hour.
Just prior to splitting cells for nucleofection, equilibrate the coated plate with 3-5 mL/well DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS supplemented with 10 uM Rock Inhibitor.

steps.title: Prepare DNA Aliquots
steps.instruction: Aliquot DNA into 1.7 mL tubes according to the provided table.

steps.title: Harvest Cells for Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Dissociate and collect the iPSCs required for the nucleofection process.

substeps.instruction: Wash wells with 1-2 mL PBS per well.
Add 1 mL of accutase per well.
Incubate at 37 °C for 5-10 minutes (check at 5 minutes) until single cell dissociation is achieved.
Collect cells in 5 mL PBS and transfer to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge at 750-800 rpm for 3 minutes.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 3 mL PBS in the 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Calculate and Isolate Cell Volume
steps.instruction: Determine the volume of the cell suspension needed to obtain 3 million cells per nucleofection.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 10 µL of the suspension into a cell counter.
Calculate the average number of cells using all four corners of the Countess slide.
Calculate total cells: (average number of cells) x 10,000 x 3.
Divide the total number of cells by 3 million.
Divide the resulting answer by 3 to determine the volume of cells necessary for nucleofection.
Transfer the calculated volume of cells to a microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge cells at 90 xg for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Perform Nucleofection
steps.instruction: Combine cells, DNA, and reaction mix for electroporation.

substeps.instruction: Prepare the reaction mix using Lonza Kit: P3 Primary Cell 4D (V4XP-3024), totaling 100 µL per nucleofection (or a master mix for multiple).
Combine 100 µL of Reaction Mix with the previously aliquoted DNA.
Mix the Reaction Mix and DNA with the cell pellet by pipetting up and down with a p200 pipette; pipette minimally, only until mixed.
Transfer 100 µL of the mixture to a cuvette.
Use a dropper to add a small amount of media to the cuvette to ensure all cells are recovered.
Transfer the cells/DNA solution to a pre-coated well containing 2 mL of DMEM/F12 + 10% FBS + 10 uM Rock Inhibitor.

steps.title: Post-Nucleofection Culture and Recovery
steps.instruction: Culture the iPSCs and gradually reduce Rock Inhibitor concentration over 5-7 days.

substeps.instruction: Incubate cells at 37 °C overnight.
Continue culturing in 1 well of a 6-well plate for 5-7 days, changing mTesR1 daily.
At 24 hours post-nucleofection: add mTesR1 with 5 uM Rock Inhibitor.
At 48 hours post-nucleofection: add mTesR1 with 2.5 uM Rock Inhibitor.
At 72 hours post-nucleofection: add mTesR1 with 1 uM Rock Inhibitor.
Continue culturing in mTesR1 until confluent; maintain for at least 5 days post-nucleofection prior to screening to minimize chimeric clones.
